# Systems Manager

Store versioned parameters, publish documents, and send Run Command requests.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#systems-manager) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- ExpirationNotification and NoChangeNotification policies are stored and reported but send no events.
- Shared parameters, advanced data types and quotas are not implemented.
- Document sharing is recorded and reported but does not make a document visible to other accounts.
- Documents are not run: only Command documents can be sent; Automation, State Manager, Inventory, Session Manager and patching are missing.
- No command runs on an instance: each invocation finishes as Success with empty output about a second after SendCommand, unless cancelled first.
- SendCommand targets running EC2 instances and tag:<key> or InstanceIds targets; notifications, alarms, document hashes and rate controls are not supported.
- Output is never written to S3 or CloudWatch Logs, though the settings are recorded.
- The dedicated console covers Parameter Store; documents, Run Command and parameter policies remain CLI/SDK workflows.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
